tagline: Custom calculations with Genie Code: Genie Code can now write custom calculations that reference other custom calculations in the same dataset.
what_it_does: Custom calculations with Genie Code: Genie Code can now write custom calculations that reference other custom calculations in the same dataset. Sort pivot tables: Viewers can now sort pivot tables by row and column. Pivot table header styles: Authors can now style pivot table headers separately for each row, column, and value field.
why_it_matters: Field types and scale types A variable can contain fields of different types.
